# GRABMyo required inputs

Copy the Day27-equivalent GRABMyo artifacts already completed in your real repository into this canonical directory. This starter pack does not invent their contents.

Required references:

```text
dataset-source-record.yaml
license-record.yaml
label-dictionary.yaml
canonical-mapping.yaml
data-hierarchy.yaml
field-dictionary.csv
file/remote-object inventory
split manifest
test seal
readiness decision
```
